description: This file defines an interface for building answer responses to RetrieveFeatures commands within the Eclipse Ditto project's signaling framework. It specifies methods for creating successful and error responses related to feature retrieval operations.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending query command response builder, for constructing responses to RetrieveFeatures commands.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface defining factory methods for creating response objects for RetrieveFeatures commands, including success responses with feature data and error responses.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing the retrieved features.

methods.name: featuresNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating that features could not be retrieved due to access issues.
